mechanism.plausibility_rationale: Non-selective NSAIDs are well-documented to increase the risk of cardiovascular events, including myocardial infarction, due to the inhibition of COX-2-mediated prostacyclin production while COX-1-mediated thromboxane A2 production remains relatively unopposed, leading to a pro-thrombotic state.
